name: Pay 2 life for a shockland that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, once open-land-unlocks has had first refusal, play a shockland from hand and pay the 2 life when doing so makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - Godless Shrine unlocking Thoughtseize with nothing else up. A free untapped land always wins when one is available (this play's false repeats U's own key), and life stays unspent below 8: at 7 or less the 2 life is not worth a turn 1-2 card this early. Also stands down once a fetch in hand could reach a FREE BASIC unlock (unlocks_by_basic_search, not F's broader unlocks_by_search - a fetch that can only reach a non-basic unlock, a shockland the library holds but no basic, never makes this play stand down, since F itself would then pay the fetch's own life cost on top of the shock's; hand Strand+Godless Shrine+Thoughtseize with only a library Godless Shrine reachable is exactly that case - this play still pays for the hand Shrine). Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack. Stands down against eldrazi-ramp only: that matchup is at the per-archetype active-play cap once orchid-phantom-breaks-tron and ephemerate-protect-lone-creature are both counted, and paying 2 life for an untapped shockland is worth less against a deck with no early clock than either of those two plays, the same trade fetch-surveil-land-keep already makes there. Every other matchup is unchanged.
